subject.title: refactor(memory): move QMD coordination to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw accept the public `runtime.state.withLease` contract and unsupported mixed-version cutover as the permanent replacement for QMD file locks?
rationale: The implementation direction aligns with database-first policy, but the API permanence and restart-only upgrade boundary are product and compatibility choices that tests cannot decide.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept the public lease API and clean-restart boundary after the rebased head demonstrates a real upgrade plus concurrent gateway and CLI QMD operation.

options.title: Keep the lease internal
options.body: Retain SQLite coordination but expose it only through the bundled Memory Core host facade until a broader external-plugin use case justifies public SDK support.

options.title: Retain file locks
options.body: Pause this refactor and keep the already-merged file-lock implementation if the migration and public-contract costs outweigh the storage-policy benefit.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the public lease API and clean-restart boundary after the rebased head demonstrates a real upgrade plus concurrent gateway and CLI QMD operation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the current QMD locking implementation and the proposed database-first replacement.
